verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right structure: logo, then a headline column, then details and pills, then the can. Its flaws are the undersized RSVP button, which looks no more important than the pills, the orphaned word 'year' in the subtitle, legal text squeezed along the bottom, and a missing-asset placeholder plus the can crowding the right edge. B is a jumble: the headline sits at bottom-left beneath 'Solstice Presents', and the subtitle is a narrow column wedged between the headline and the date. The RSVP button is the same size as the Free Entry, All Ages and Tastings pills and sits in the same row, which buries it. The pill row and the URL text also crowd right up against 'Sessions', and the legal text and placeholder are crammed into the right corner.
